title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
slides: Will ChatGPT now replace your company's website?
OpenAI launched business profiles inside ChatGPT itself
Profiles surface details before users ever click through
Your company page may soon appear directly in chats
Claim your profile before competitors do
thread_text:
1. ChatGPT Replaces Your Website?

OpenAI just launched business profiles inside ChatGPT itself. Users now see your company details before they ever click through.

2. Profiles Before the Click

Every business now gets a profile card that surfaces key details right in the chat. This means users can evaluate you without visiting your site.

3. Your Site Loses Traffic

As profiles get richer, fewer users will bother clicking to your actual website. Your online presence is shifting to a platform you don't control.

4. Competitors Are Claiming Profiles

Early movers are already setting up their profiles, making it harder for laggards to stand out. The race for visibility inside ChatGPT is on.

5. Claim Your Profile Now

Go to ChatGPT and search for your business. If it's not there, claim it today—before someone else does.
